data.purpose: Doctors who work at the hospital.
data.columnsInfo: id, doctor_code, first_name, last_name, email, phone, gender, qualification, experience_years, consultation_fee, is_deleted
data.hints: Always filter is_deleted = false. A doctor's specialty is found by joining to specialties through doctor_specialties_map.
The specialty name is in specialties.name (e.g. 'Cardiology'). Filter is_deleted = false.

data.purpose: Link table connecting doctors and specialties (many-to-many).
data.hints: Join doctors.id = doctor_specialties_map.doctor_id and specialties.id = doctor_specialties_map.specialty_id.

data.columnsInfo: id, patient_code, first_name, last_name, date_of_birth, gender, phone, email, address, blood_group, is_deleted
data.hints: Filter is_deleted = false. Table name is singular: patient.

data.purpose: Appointments between a patient and a doctor.
data.columnsInfo: id, patient_id, doctor_id, appointment_date, start_time, end_time, duration_minutes, status, is_deleted
data.hints: Join appointments.doctor_id = doctors.id and appointments.patient_id = patient.id. status is an enum. Filter is_deleted = false.

data.purpose: The weekly working hours of each doctor: which days they work, from when to when, and their daily break.
data.columnsInfo: id, doctor_id, day_of_week, start_time, end_time, break_start_time, break_end_time, is_deleted
data.hints: Join doctor_availabilities.doctor_id = doctors.id. Filter is_deleted = false. day_of_week is text holding an uppercase English day name: MONDAY, TUESDAY, WEDNESDAY, THURSDAY, FRIDAY, SATURDAY, SUNDAY - compare it as a string, never as a number. start_time and end_time are TIME columns (e.g. 09:00:00) and are never null. break_start_time and break_end_time are TIME columns that CAN be null, meaning that day has no break - use them only with a null check. There is at most ONE row per doctor per day (unique on doctor_id + day_of_week), so counting rows for a doctor gives the number of days they work. A doctor with no row for a day does not work that day. To ask about today, compare day_of_week to UPPER(DAYNAME(CURDATE())). Working minutes for a day = TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, start_time, end_time) minus the break when both break columns are set.
